cobol_source:
****************************************************************     
* PROGRAM NAME                 : CBFLIGHT                      *     
* IMPORTANTE FILE              : DB2 TABLE FLIGHT              *     
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      *     
* DATA OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    *     
****************************************************************     
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        *     
*                                                              *     
*           DUPLICATE DATA IN THE FLIGHT TABLE DB2             *     
****************************************************************     
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            *     
*                                                              *     
* DATA IN THE DB2 TABLE                                        *     
****************************************************************     
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           *     
*                                                              *     
* DUPLICATE DATA WITH OTHERS DATES IN THE SAME TABLE           *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                                            
 PROGRAM-ID. CBFLIGHT.                                               
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                        DATA DIVISION.                        *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 DATA DIVISION.                                                      
                                                                     
*------------------------*                                           
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.                                            
*------------------------*                                           
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                   TABLE FLIGHT DECLARATION                   *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 01  WS-FLIGHT.                                                      
     02 WS-TABLE-FLIGHT OCCURS 31.                                   
        03 WS-FLIGHTID                    PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-FLIGHTDATE.                                            
           04 WS-YEAR                     PIC 9(4).                  
           04 FILLER                      PIC X.                     
           04 WS-MONTHDATE                PIC 9(2).                  
           04 FILLER                      PIC X.                     
           04 WS-DAY                      PIC 9(2).                  
        03 WS-DEPTIME                     PIC X(8).                  
        03 WS-ARRTIME                     PIC X(8).                  
        03 WS-TOTPASS                     PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-TOTBAGGA                    PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-FLIGHTNUM                   PIC X(6).                  
        03 WS-SHIFTID                     PIC S9(9) USAGE COMP.      
        03 WS-AIRPLANEID                  PIC X(8).                  
        03 WS-AIRPORTDEP                  PIC X(4).                  
        03 WS-AIRPORTARR                  PIC X(4).                  
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                      TABLE MONTHS AND DAYS                   *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 01  MONTH                                PIC X(24)                  
                VALUE  '312831303130313130313031'.                   
                                                                     
 01  MONTH-RED REDEFINES MONTH.                                      
     02 WS-MONTH                          PIC 9(2) OCCURS 12.        
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                          COUNTERS                            *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 01  COUNT1                            PIC 9(2).                     
 01  COUNT2                            PIC 9(2).                     
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                   FLIGHT'S NAME = FLIGHTNUM                  *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 01  FLIGHTNUM-TABLE                   PIC X(48)                     
       VALUE  'CB1104CB1105CB2204CB2205CB3304CB3305CB4404CB4405'.    
                                                                     
 01  WS-FLIGHTNUM REDEFINES FLIGHTNUM-TABLE.                         
     02 WS-FLIGHTNUM-F                 PIC X(6) OCCURS 8.            
                                                                     
 01  WS-FLIGHTNUM-DEF                  PIC X(6).                     
****************************************************************     
*                        SQL DECLARATION.                      *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         INCLUDE FLIGHT                                              
     END-EXEC.                                                       
                                                                     
     EXEC SQL                                                        
         INCLUDE SQLCA                                               
     END-EXEC.                                                       
                                                                     
****************************************************************     
*                       PROCEDURE DIVISION.                    *     
****************************************************************     
                                                                     
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                 
                                                                     
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT2 FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT2 > 8             
                                                                     
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DB2-DATA                                     
        PERFORM 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA                                   
        PERFORM 0300-INSERT-DATA                                      
                                                                      
     END-PERFORM.                                                     
                                                                      
     GOBACK.                                                          
                                                                      
****************************************************************      
* 0100-GET-DB2-DATA                                            *      
*                                                              *      
* IT GETS THE INFORMATION FROM THE DB2 TABLE                   *      
****************************************************************      
                                                                      
 0100-GET-DB2-DATA.                                                   
                                                                      
     MOVE WS-FLIGHTNUM-F(COUNT2) TO WS-FLIGHTNUM-DEF                  
                                                                      
     EXEC SQL                                                         
         SELECT *                                                     
         INTO :DCLFLIGHT                                              
         FROM FLIGHT                                                  
         WHERE FLIGHTNUM = :WS-FLIGHTNUM-DEF                          
*          AND (FLIGHTDATE = '01/09/2022')                            
     END-EXEC                                                         
                                                                      
     IF SQLCODE NOT = 0                                               
        DISPLAY 'EXTRACTION ERROR DATA'                               
        DISPLAY 'THE FLIGHTNUM IS: ' WS-FLIGHTNUM-F(COUNT2)           
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' SQLCODE                                     
        DISPLAY 'STATE: ' SQLSTATE                                    
     END-IF.                                                          
                                                                      
****************************************************************      
* 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA                                          *      
*                                                              *      
* IT GET THE INFROMATION FOR THE FIRST MONTH DAY AND DUPLICATE *    
* IT TO THE WHOLE MONTH.                                       *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA.                                               
                                                                    
     MOVE DCLFLIGHT TO WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(1)                           
                                                                    
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT1 FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT1 > WS-MONTH(9)  
                                                                    
        MOVE WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(1) TO WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(COUNT1)          
        MOVE COUNT1 TO WS-DAY(COUNT1)                               
        DISPLAY WS-FLIGHTDATE(COUNT1)                               
                                                                    
     END-PERFORM.                                                   
                                                                    
****************************************************************    
* 0300-INSERT-DATA                                             *    
*                                                              *    
* IT PUT THE NEW DUPLICATE DATA INTO THE DB2 TABLE             *    
****************************************************************    
                                                                    
 0300-INSERT-DATA.                                                  
                                                                    
     PERFORM VARYING COUNT1 FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL COUNT1 > WS-MONTH(9)  
                                                                    
        MOVE WS-TABLE-FLIGHT(COUNT1) TO DCLFLIGHT                   
                                                                    
        EXEC SQL                                                    
            INSERT INTO FLIGHT (FLIGHTDATE, DEPTIME, ARRTIME,       
                   TOTPASS,TOTBAGGA, FLIGHTNUM, SHIFTID,            
                   AIRPLANEID, AIRPORTDEP, AIRPORTARR)              
            VALUES (:FLIGHTDATE, :DEPTIME, :ARRTIME, :TOTPASS,      
                    :TOTBAGGA, :FLIGHTNUM, :SHIFTID,                
                    :AIRPLANEID, :AIRPORTDEP, :AIRPORTARR)          
        END-EXEC                                                    
                                                         
        IF SQLCODE NOT = 0 
           DISPLAY 'EXTRACTION ERROR DATA' 
           DISPLAY 'IN COUNTER: ' COUNT1 
           DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' SQLCODE 
           DISPLAY 'STATE: ' SQLSTATE 
        END-IF 
                                                         
     END-PERFORM.

plan.approach: The COBOL batch program CBFLIGHT is migrated to a layered Spring Boot 3 / Java 17 REST application. The three COBOL paragraphs (0100-GET-DB2-DATA, 0200-DUPLICATE-DATA, 0300-INSERT-DATA) map directly to three private service methods inside FlightDuplicateService. The outer PERFORM VARYING COUNT2 loop over the eight hard-coded flight numbers becomes the executeFullBatch() public method, which in turn calls processOneFlight() for each entry. Two REST endpoints expose the functionality: a batch endpoint that runs all eight numbers and a single-flight endpoint for ad-hoc use. The hard-coded FLIGHTNUM-TABLE and MONTH arrays are preserved as Java constants (FLIGHT_NUMBERS list and DAYS_PER_MONTH array), keeping the September-30-days logic identical to the COBOL WS-MONTH(9) reference.
patterns_used: DTO / Record pattern for request and response objects
Constant Table Extraction (COBOL VALUE clauses → Java static final fields)
plan.sql_strategy: The single COBOL EXEC SQL SELECT INTO is converted to a Spring Data JPA custom JPQL query method findFirstByFlightNum() in FlightRepository, returning Optional<Flight>. The EXEC SQL INSERT is replaced by flightRepository.save(flight) inside a try/catch block that mirrors the COBOL IF SQLCODE NOT = 0 / DISPLAY error handling, appending error messages to a result list instead of printing to stdout. The @Transactional annotation on processOneFlight() ensures each flight number's inserts are atomic; exceptions are caught per-row so that a single bad insert does not abort the remaining days – matching the COBOL continue-on-error behaviour.
plan.call_strategy: There are no CALL statements in this COBOL program. The EXEC SQL INCLUDE FLIGHT copybook is represented by the Flight JPA entity class. The EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA is replaced by Spring's exception handling infrastructure (DataAccessException hierarchy) and the GlobalExceptionHandler. The COBOL GOBACK is the natural end of the Java main() / executeFullBatch() method.
